experimental_candidate.attention_source:
def triangle_attention(module, z, mask, *, ending, extension, valid_length, chunk_size=128, fuse_softmax=False):
    """Original attention arithmetic with bounded outer-axis temporary storage."""
    import torch
    if ending:
        z = z.transpose(-2, -3)
        mask = mask.transpose(-1, -2)
    z = module.layernorm(norm_ext.transpose_cast(z)).to(z.dtype) if ending else module.layernorm(z)
    batch, length, _, channels = z.shape
    heads, width = module.num_heads, module.channel_hidden
    q, k, v = module.linear_qkv(z).chunk(3, dim=-1)
    q, k, v = [t.reshape(batch, length, length, heads, width).transpose(-2, -3)
               for t in (q, k, v)]
    bias = module.linear_bias(z).permute(0, 3, 1, 2).unsqueeze(1)
    if extension is not None:
        bias = bias.contiguous()
    mask = mask[:, :, None, None, :]
    gate = module.linear_g(z).sigmoid().reshape(batch, length, length, heads, width)
    q *= module.scale
    chunks = []
    for offset in range(0, length, chunk_size):
        stop = min(offset + chunk_size, length)
        logits = q[:, offset:stop] @ k[:, offset:stop].transpose(-1, -2)
        if extension is not None and fuse_softmax:
            probabilities = extension.mask_softmax(logits, bias, offset, valid_length, 2)
        else:
            if extension is None:
                logits += (-module.inf) * (~mask[:, offset:stop].bool()).to(q.dtype)
                logits += bias
            else:
                extension.mask_bias_(logits, bias, offset, valid_length)
            probabilities = logits.softmax(-1)
        chunks.append((probabilities @ v[:, offset:stop]).transpose(-2, -3))
        del logits, probabilities
    output = module.linear_out((torch.cat(chunks, dim=1) * gate).flatten(-2))
    return output.transpose(-2, -3) if ending else output

import hashlib,inspect,json,pathlib,runpy,sys
from types import SimpleNamespace
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load
from fireprot.adapters.atlasfold import runtime
source=pathlib.Path('/tmp/fireprot_atlas_norm_layout_probe.cu')
build=pathlib.Path('/media/IntelSSD/fireprot/runtime/atlas_norm_layout_probe')
ext=load(name='atlas_norm_layout_probe',sources=[str(source)],build_directory=str(build),extra_cuda_cflags=['-O3'],verbose=False)
counts={'transpose_cast':0}
def transpose_cast(x):
    counts['transpose_cast']+=1
    return ext.transpose_cast(x)
original=inspect.getsource(runtime.triangle_attention)
assert original.count('z = module.layernorm(z)')==1
candidate=original.replace('z = module.layernorm(z)', 'z = module.layernorm(norm_ext.transpose_cast(z)).to(z.dtype) if ending else module.layernorm(z)')
namespace={'norm_ext':SimpleNamespace(transpose_cast=transpose_cast)}
exec(compile(candidate,'<norm-layout-experimental-attention>','exec'),namespace)
runtime.triangle_attention=namespace['triangle_attention']
try:
    runpy.run_module('benchmarks.atlasfold.profile_inference',run_name='__main__')
finally:
    path=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--out')+1])/'manifest.json'
    if path.exists():
        report=json.loads(path.read_text())
        report['experimental_candidate']={'name':'exact-transpose-cast-before-native-layernorm','counts':counts,'kernel_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'script_sha256':hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'attention_source':candidate}
        path.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')

snapshot=root/'runtime/atlasfold_ab_0f15349'
out=root/'outputs/atlasfold/repeated-pairs-0f15349'
assert not snapshot.exists() and not out.exists(), 'Refusing to overwrite an existing experiment'
snapshot.mkdir();out.mkdir()
for name in ('fireprot','benchmarks'):
 shutil.copytree(root/name,snapshot/name,ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('__pycache__','*.pyc'))
files=[p for p in snapshot.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
hashes={str(p.relative_to(snapshot)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
expected=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/tmp/fireprot_atlas_repeat_source_hashes.json').read_text())
actual={p:h for p,h in hashes.items() if pathlib.Path(p).suffix in ('.py','.cu','.cpp','.h','.hpp')}
assert actual==expected, 'Snapshot source differs from the committed local tree'
(snapshot/'source-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(hashes,indent=2)+'\n')
env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=str(snapshot),FIREPROT_EXTENSION_CACHE=str(root/'runtime/torch_extensions'))
python='/media/PM982/engramfold/folding_e2e_20260921/venvs/atlasfold-rocm/bin/python'
report={'status':'running','source_commit':'0f15349f41492ddf0a3540ef80b5a6d728055a76','snapshot':str(snapshot),'source_hashes':hashes,'seed':102,'length':1536,'pairs':[],'controller_pid':os.getpid()}
def save(): (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
def verify_snapshot():
 for relative,expected in hashes.items():
  assert hashlib.sha256((snapshot/relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,relative
save()
try:
 with (out/'prime.log').open('w') as log:
  subprocess.run([python,'-c','from fireprot.backends.amd.pair_fusions import load,manifest; assert load() is not None,manifest(); print(manifest())'],cwd=snapshot,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 for pair in range(3):
  records={}
  for backend in ('chunked','hip-fused'):
   verify_snapshot();dest=out/f'pair{pair}-{backend}'
   cmd=[python,'-m','benchmarks.atlasfold.profile_inference','--input',str(root/'benchmarks/protenix/inputs/umem_L01536_6b140cc19f02d9b9.json'),'--out',str(dest),'--backend',backend,'--allow-long1536','--seed','102','--repeats','1','--stage-events','off']
   report['active']={'pair':pair,'backend':backend,'command':cmd};save()
   with (out/f'pair{pair}-{backend}.log').open('w') as log:
    subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=snapshot,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
   manifest=json.loads((dest/'manifest.json').read_text())
   assert manifest['status']=='complete' and manifest['isolation']['passed']
   counts=manifest['fireprot']['counts']
   assert counts['native_fallback']==0
   if backend=='hip-fused':assert counts['fused_attention']==528 and counts['hip_multiplication']==528
   else:assert counts['chunked_attention']==528
   records[backend]={'request_seconds':manifest['first_request_seconds'],'prediction_seconds':manifest['records'][0]['prediction_wall_seconds'],'device':manifest['device'],'manifest':str(dest/'manifest.json')}
  a=np.load(out/f'pair{pair}-chunked/repeat0-seed102-sample0.npz');b=np.load(out/f'pair{pair}-hip-fused/repeat0-seed102-sample0.npz')
  comparison={k:a[k].shape==b[k].shape and a[k].dtype==b[k].dtype and a[k].tobytes()==b[k].tobytes() for k in a.files}
  assert set(a.files)==set(b.files) and all(comparison.values()),comparison
  assert records['chunked']['device']==records['hip-fused']['device']
  report['pairs'].append({'pair':pair,'records':records,'raw_bytes_equal':comparison,'request_speedup':records['chunked']['request_seconds']/records['hip-fused']['request_seconds']});save()
  print(json.dumps(report['pairs'][-1]),flush=True)
 verify_snapshot()
 report['medians']={backend:statistics.median(p['records'][backend]['request_seconds'] for p in report['pairs']) for backend in ('chunked','hip-fused')}
 report['median_request_speedup']=report['medians']['chunked']/report['medians']['hip-fused']
 report['status']='complete';report.pop('active',None);save()
except BaseException as error:
 report['status']='failed';report['error']=repr(error);save();raise
